primaryItems.title: React vs Vue.js Comparison
primaryItems.description: React uses a virtual DOM and component-centric approach with JSX, whereas Vue provides dynamic template syntax and reactive data-binding out of the box.

claims.text: React requires understanding JSX and building custom routing and state solutions using external libraries.
Vue features an easier learning curve with simple HTML/CSS template structures, ideal for beginners and school projects.

sources.title: React (software) - Wikipedia
sources.excerpt: React is a free and open-source front-end JavaScript library for building user interfaces based on components, maintained by Meta and community.

sources.title: Vue.js - Wikipedia
sources.excerpt: Vue.js is an open-source model–view–viewmodel front-end JavaScript framework for building user interfaces and single-page applications.
